use_cases: Slide-up pricing panel for product pages in e-commerce or SaaS applications
Display subscription or lifetime access information with animated transitions
Mobile-friendly overlay for quick actions or checkout flows
Contextual information drawer that slides smoothly from bottom of screen
Modal alternative with natural spring-based animations for better UX
ai_summary: A smooth slide-up drawer component featuring spring-based animations with translateY and subtle 3D rotation effects. Built with motion/react for fluid open/close transitions, includes support for headers, footers, and pricing displays with gradient text styling. Supports dark mode and is optimized for both desktop and mobile platforms.
